Il lessico BI-RADS per l'ecografia descr:
The BI-RADS ultrasound lexicon describes a mass with a few words: shape (oval, round, irregular), orientation (parallel to the skin = wider than tall; not parallel = taller than wide), margins (circumscribed, or indistinct, angular, microlobulated, spiculated), echo pattern (anechoic, hypoechoic, complex…) and posterior features (enhancement, shadowing, none).
The simple cyst is the most common breast lesion. To call it «simple» all four criteria are needed: anechoic, circumscribed, thin wall, posterior enhancement. Then it is BI-RADS 2.
If they are not all met (internal echoes, septa, thick wall, solid component) it is a complicated cyst or a complex mass: the category goes up (3 or 4).
